'''Li Jianrong''' ({{zh|c=李建榕|p=Lǐ Jiànróng}}; born 1966) is a Chinese engineer, currently serving as deputy director of Shenyang Engine Design and Research Institute of the [[Aviation Industry Corporation of China]] (AVIC) and chief engineer of AVIC Aerospace Research Institute.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.sasac.gov.cn/n4470048/n4470081/n7799730/n7799735/n7799755/c7806668/content.html |script-title=zh:“航空发动机是我人生最好的选择”——记中国航发研究院常务副院长、总研究师李建榕 |work=sasac.gov.cn |date=30 August 2017 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

Li is an alternate of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Xu Kun ({{lang|zh|徐锟}}) |url=http://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202210/22/WS63537f11a310817f312f2d1a.html |script-title=zh:中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员名单（171名） |work=Chinadaily |date=22 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Li was born in 1966. She worked at the AVIC Aerospace Research Institute before being appointed [[Chinese Communist Party Committee Secretary|party secretary]] and vice president of the AVIC Gas Turbine Institute.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.kepuchina.cn/kpcs/fcl/kjmj1/201712/t20171218_341475.shtml |script-title=zh:她的生命里，每个细胞都充满航空动力 |work=kepuchina.cn |date=18 December 2017 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2010 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Special) for the main development technologies of "Taihang" engine
